ms.description: Milliseconds from the start of the video, as the file plays.

frame.description: A frame number, counted from 0, at the payload's fps.

region.description: A place on the frame the comment is about, as it looked at the comment's moment, or at the start of its stretch.

shape.description: box: an area. point: a spot.

x.description: The box's left edge, or the point, as a fraction of the frame's width from its left.

y.description: The box's top edge, or the point, as a fraction of the frame's height from its top.

width.description: The box's width, as a fraction of the frame's width.

height.description: The box's height, as a fraction of the frame's height.

px.description: The same place in the video's own pixels, origin top left.

verdict.description: approve: the video can go out as it is; any comments are remarks. request_changes: apply the comments and send the next cut with --revises.

note.description: About the video as a whole.

video.description: The video as it was watched: the frame of reference for every time and place below. Missing only when the file could not be played.

comments.description: What to change, in time order. Each is at a moment (at_ms) or over a stretch (start_ms to end_ms), and is about the picture or the sound.

on.description: picture: what is seen. sound: what is heard, whatever is on screen.

end_frame.description: The last frame of the stretch, inclusive.

scenes.description: The ids of the payload's scenes the comment touches, in order.
